name: My Night Job
source:
For a while, you worked peacefully in a store. In a regular store for people. But in an instant, everything changed - monsters came to your world. More precisely, they were always here, just not showing.

 Everything was more or less normal: you hardly met aggressive customers, but tonight will not be calm.

[From [url=https://lowula.itch.io/my-night-job]itch.io[/url]]
